public.release_body:
Operator prerequisite: PowerShell7 for the verified backup/restore/offline migration path (tested7.6.5). Native Windows PowerShell5.1 Start is verified separately; its full backup chain is unverified on this host. Frozen ZIP PowerShell5 backup examples are build-time snapshots: use pwsh for the verified backup/restore/migration path. Install PowerShell7 from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/scripting/install/install-powershell-on-windows . Follow the pinned current operator guide: https://github.com/erkevibe/process-intelligence-rs/blob/23decaaab8cbf7cb2737a4120edfb7f25c8b7dc5/docs/STORAGE_V2.md

Selected local-platform iteration0.5: metadata-only navigation, individual journal/model loading and a global clean cache limited to128MiB charged estimate/eight entries. Oversized resources bypass retention; eviction never deletes database records. Current authorization and record versions are checked before disclosure. Existing schema2 and delta/CAS persistence are retained.

Two heavy HTTP operations are admitted globally. Blocking workers and outgoing byte owners retain admission; ordinary and Completed SSE output is incrementally framed. Idle SSE, health, status and cancellation remain available. This is a retained-cache contract, not a physical-memory ceiling; active jobs/uploads/validation/backup/allocator/OS pages remain separate.

Fixed identical corpus: three full six-log projects, three A→B→C→A cycles,72 full exports and18 canonical hashes equal the accepted0.4 baseline. Sampled application WorkingSet maximum405,127,168 bytes versus1,109,307,392; quiescent maximum186,798,080 versus1,089,306,624. Actual sampling average167ms despite100ms target; lifetime peak414,781,440 reported separately. No universal worst-case or enterprise/parity claim.

Independent checks include actual concurrent slow ordinary/Completed SSE output, idle subscriptions, oversize/single-flight/eviction, current-role denial, corruption/CAS/delta preservation, real Running+Queued application crash and owned PostgreSQL WAL restart, unchanged historical full values/versions, healthy subsequent writes, native Windows cold/restored startup and isolated Datastar/browser scenarios. Ordinary tests70PASS/13explicitignored; applicable real PostgreSQL regressions are separate.

Schema2 from0.4 needs no migration. For schema1 use a separately restored copy and explicit offline migration. Whole-project downloadable backup retains20MiB limit and temporarily materializes one full project. Full PostgreSQL backup/new restore preserves all94 normalized historical records and12 legacy KV values/versions. Existing-target, corrupt archive and active-app migration refusals are checked. Legacy disk duplicates remain; PowerShell5 backup remains UNVERIFIED.

Extract to a fresh directory and run Windows PowerShell with documented child-process policy:
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Start.ps1 -Port 3050 -PostgresPort 5439
Open http://127.0.0.1:3050 and create your first local account. These example ports must be free; existing installations remain separate. Preserve the protected .local data directory. For backup/restore/migration use the pinned operator guide and PowerShell7.6.5.

This release continues partial R3 and provides measured R6 groundwork. Full Apromore compatibility, complete BPMN, IANA/DST, distributed jobs, HA and enterprise readiness remain future work. User acceptance is separate from automated and Council acceptance.
